subject.title: fix: suppress exec-like tool error warnings regardless of includeDetails

question: Should exec-like failures with `includeDetails: true` be suppressed in all contexts, or should cron, heartbeat, and full-verbose diagnostics remain visible?
rationale: Current tests preserve detail-bearing exec warnings, while the PR and linked issue ask for suppress-all behavior; automation cannot safely rewrite the branch ordering and tests without that policy choice.

options.title: Keep Diagnostic Detail Exceptions
options.body: Preserve current cron, heartbeat, and full-verbose diagnostics, and revise the PR to suppress only unwanted normal-turn exec warnings with regression coverage.

options.title: Suppress All Exec-Like Warnings
options.body: Move exec-like suppression before mutating handling and intentionally update tests and proof for hidden cron, heartbeat, and full-verbose details.

options.title: Narrow Or Close The Linked Issue
options.body: Decide the current detail-mode behavior is intended and narrow the linked issue to the remaining warning-noise cases or close it with the documented contract.

recommendation.title: Keep Diagnostic Detail Exceptions
recommendation.body: Preserve current cron, heartbeat, and full-verbose diagnostics, and revise the PR to suppress only unwanted normal-turn exec warnings with regression coverage.
